scenario: LCON.2.7.1 float determinism — sqrt is the fifth IEEE 754 basic op (√). It is correctly-rounded, hence bit-exact across platforms (unlike transcendentals, which live under tolerance). `sqrt(2.0)` is the exact double 1.4142135623730951; the inline guard fires only on an exact bit match.
rules_ds:
from math import sqrt

schema T scope logical:
    x: Float key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where sqrt(t.x) == 1.4142135623730951
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
